method: Primary agent opened the listed local images with view_image. Motion/chapter sheets are decoded time-order frames, not continuous real-time video viewing. Final notice/search/dodge/exit sheets were reopened after the QA timestamp-to-PTS correction; hashes here identify those final decoded sheets.
observations: Half-turn shows intermediate head/body directions and foot changes instead of one rendered body flip.
Notice/pursuit sequence shows the actual face, chest and limbs emerging past shelving before the player turns into cover.
Search sequence shows the same actor approach, look sideways and turn its back through the safe grille opening.
Dodge sequence shows lateral separation after the committed attack and the actor during recovery.
Exit handle becomes visible by player look input, door descends, result remains visible after the ending interval.
320x568 at fontScale2 keeps the entire length board between the heading and scrolling controls; assistance buttons can be reached at the bottom.
limits: No iPhone/EXGL/Metal or native Yoga/text metrics measurement.
No real finger or VoiceOver session, audio listening, FPS, fear or illusion-perception evaluation.
Images do not prove human-perceived motion smoothness; MP4 artifacts are provided for that review.
